title: Video by jamesharrisjrmd
description:
I need your help finding someone who changed my life.

His name is Henry Ray, and he was my counselor at Ted C. Wills RESTART High School in Fresno, California.

He helped me find a path to college at a time in my life when that future was far from certain.

I went on to college, but I never got to tell Mr. Ray how much what he did for me mattered.

I’d like to change that.

If you attended Ted C. Wills RESTART, worked for Fresno Unified, or recognize his name, please comment, DM me, or share this with someone who might know him.

Maybe the internet can help me finally say thank you.

Please share this post and help me find Henry Ray so I can finally tell him how much he changed my life.

#surgery #FresnoCalifornia #FresnoUnified #TedCWills #FindHenryRay
